title: Notable Quotes
description: Use XMLHttpRequest to fetch quotes from a web API and display successful responses or error messages in the webpage.

instructions.studentPrompt:
Complete quote.js so the webpage fetches and displays quotes from the zyBooks quote API.

The quote API endpoint is:
https://wp.zybooks.com/quotes.php

The API accepts these query-string parameters:

- topic: The requested quote topic. Valid topics are love, motivational, wisdom, and humor.
- count: The number of quotes requested. The value must be from 1 through 5.

For example:
https://wp.zybooks.com/quotes.php?topic=love&count=3

Modify fetchQuotes(topic, count) so it:

- Creates a new XMLHttpRequest object.
- Opens a GET request using the exact URL format https://wp.zybooks.com/quotes.php?topic=TOPIC&count=COUNT.
- Places the topic parameter before the count parameter.
- Sets responseType to json.
- Registers responseReceivedHandler as the load-event handler using addEventListener or the onload property.
- Calls send().
- Removes the existing call to showAnonymousQuotes().

Implement responseReceivedHandler() with no parameters.

The function must read the XMLHttpRequest response using this.response.

When the response contains an array of quotes, place an ordered list inside the element with id quotes. Each list item must use this exact format:

Quote text - Source

Preserve the order of the quotes in the response.

When the response contains an error property, display the error inside a paragraph element within the quotes div.

Return the complete quote.js file.

validation: Reject explanatory text outside the JavaScript.

submissionRules.notes: Do not automatically clean or repair malformed model output. Invalid formatting should result in FORMAT_ERROR.

tests.name: Test XMLHttpRequest addEventListener() method
Test XMLHttpRequest open() method
Test XMLHttpRequest responseType
Test XMLHttpRequest send() method
Test responseReceivedHandler() with humor quote
Test responseReceivedHandler() with wisdom quotes
Test responseReceivedHandler() with error

knownIssues: The official tests replace window.XMLHttpRequest with mock implementations.
The first official test replaces the global responseReceivedHandler function.
Each test must run in a fresh page so mocked globals do not leak between tests.
The evaluator does not need live access to the quote API.
The query-string parameter order must be topic first and count second.
responseReceivedHandler must declare zero parameters and access the response through this.response.
The expected innerHTML is compared against a compact exact string.
